H_scope: Actual SceneAct compiler subset and reusable support/edit interfaces, not end-to-end natural image H
data_exposure: Engineered controlled exploratory tasks; template/fault-family knowledge used in calibration and smoke. Formal source configuration differs by predeclared dimensions/lens/placement; not new natural-image blind data.
evaluation: All nine fixed source and independent-transfer gates required. Any missing/failed required gate cannot pass. Primary effective repair = all source and transfer gates. Transfer repair = transfer all gates. Raw missing scores null; failed end-to-end utility separately zero.
model_api: Only logged-in Codex CLI, requested gpt-6-astra medium for formal diagnosis and coding; gpt-6.1-sol medium real attachment connectivity tested. No reconstruction LLM needed for deterministic synthetic SceneAct plans.
hypothesis_limitation: Visible full program can make root defect obvious. Smoke showed identical competing predictions and active abstention. No claim that formal tasks guarantee ambiguity or downstream advantage; no extra tasks/rounds based on winner.
failure_policy: No automatic call retries; service/build/invalid candidates retained. An interrupted call is not resampled; completed raw outputs can be evaluated without new model calls.
selection: No best-of selection, no multigeneration RSI. One patch per arm; full results including failure are kept.
